title: carried
description: `.gbg/carried.toml` — the findings a round closed by carrying them to the next round of its instrument. A carried finding is REAL, UNFIXED and re-banked next time, never rediscovered by chance: a fresh battery is a fresh search, and a finding left to be re-found is a finding dropped. Only `minor` and `nit` carry, and only on a severity re-rated by someone other than the lane that reported it.

round.description: the round that first carried it

severity.description: the RE-RATED severity, never the reporting lane's own

carries.description: how many rounds it has been carried through; at the limit it escalates to the owner instead

history.description: the backlog at each release, so a release can require it to be draining
